propositions: The close operation must not hold the store write lock across compaction, to prevent lock starvation in agents waiting on the close
Compaction must trigger automatically in stores with no CI and no local cron, via an operation-linked floor using detached workers and advisory locks, not just via scheduled workflows

The sweep must select tickets either lacking a snapshot with foldable events (backfill) or with foldable count exceeding threshold (recurrence), reusing the fold's own foldability predicate to prevent selection drift

The sweep must amortize git history traversal to a single walk per sweep hoisted outside the store write lock, and re-probe writer presence between chunks, to prevent per-ticket lock holds from cascading to hours of lock contention at store scale
Compaction reporting must count only tickets where a new snapshot artifact appears, not return codes, to distinguish actual folds from no-op branches
